name: Relay Module (single channel, 5V coil)
description: Generic single-channel relay module with optocoupler isolation. 5V coil, controlled by a 3.3V-compatible GPIO signal.

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Power for the relay coil — must be 5V

pins.name: IN
pins.notes: Control signal from ESP32 GPIO. Active LOW on most modules (LOW energizes the relay).

notes: The coil requires 5V — power from the DevKit's 5V (VIN) pin. The IN signal is 3.3V-compatible via the optocoupler on most modules. Most modules are ACTIVE LOW: writing LOW energizes the relay. Verify the active level for your specific module before wiring.
